gap: 1.5rem; padding: 2rem; }#screen-menu h1 { color: rgb(255, 255, 255); font-size: clamp(2rem, 8vw, 3.5rem); font-weight: 900; text-align: center; margin: 0px 0px 0.25rem; text-shadow: rgba(255, 200, 0, 0.7) 0px 0px 30px; }#screen-menu p { color: rgb(170, 170, 170); margin: 0px; text-align: center; font-size: clamp(0.9rem, 3vw, 1.1rem); }.level-grid { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 1rem; justify-content: center; max-width: 600px; }.level-card { width: clamp(130px, 38vw, 170px); background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.07); border: 2px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15); border-radius: 20px; padding: 1.2rem 1rem; text-align: center; cursor: pointer; color: rgb(255, 255, 255); transition: transform 100ms, background 120ms; }.level-card:active { transform: scale(0.93); background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.18); }.level-card .icon { font-size: 3.2rem; display: block; margin-bottom: 0.4rem; }.level-card .name { font-size: 1.05rem; font-weight: 800; }.level-card .desc { font-size: 0.8rem; color: rgb(170, 170, 170); margin-top: 0.2rem; }#screen-game { background: rgb(0, 0, 0); }#btn-back { position: absolute; top: 0.45rem; right: 0.8rem; background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.18); border-width: medium; border-style: none; border-color: currentcolor; border-image: initial; border-radius: 10px; color: rgb(255, 255, 255); font-size: 0.85rem; font-weight: 700; padding: 0.35rem 0.8rem; cursor: pointer; z-index: 20; pointer-events: auto; }#screen-gameover { background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.88); gap: 1.2rem; text-align: center; color: rgb(255, 255, 255); }#screen-gameover h2 { font-size: clamp(2rem, 7vw, 3rem); margin: 0px; }.final-score { font-size: clamp(1.6rem, 6vw, 2.4rem); color: rgb(255, 215, 0); font-weight: 900; }.btn-big { background: rgb(255, 85, 0); border-width: medium; border-style: none; border-color: currentcolor; border-image: initial; border-radius: 16px; color: rgb(255, 255, 255); font-size: 1.15rem; font-weight: 900; padding: 0.9rem 2.2rem; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: rgb(170, 51, 0) 0px 6px 0px; transition: transform 80ms, box-shadow 80ms; }.btn-big:active { transform: translateY(6px); box-shadow: none; }.btn-replay { background: rgb(34, 85, 204); box-shadow: rgb(17, 51, 136) 0px 6px 0px; }
